LTR-1863-12-16-001.ex: Wauhatchie, Tenn. I am again with the regt. and doing duty.

LTR-1864-01-03-001.ex: Capitol Hill Washington, D.C. I wish you and Frances a happy New Year. Did either of you pass a pleasant New Year's day?

LTR-1864-01-19-001.ex: Capitol Hill Washington, D.C. I rec'd. your welcome letter of Jan.

LTR-1864-01-29-001.ex: Capitol Hill Washington, D.C. I rec'd. your welcome and long looked for letter of Jan. 20 yesterday.

LTR-1864-02-15-001.ex: Capitol Hill Washington, D.C. I rec'd. Alex's letter of Feb. 9th enclosing one dollar two or three days since.

LTR-1864-02-17-001.ex: Capitol Hill Washington, D.C. Military movements are sudden so you must not be surprised to hear that we are to leave...

LTR-1864-02-18-001.ex: Nashville, Tenn. I wrote you a day or two at on from Louisville, Ky.

LTR-1864-02-21-001.ex: Stephenson, Ala. It is a most beautiful Sabbath morning.

LTR-1864-02-24-001.ex: Charleston, S.C. We reached this place yesterday afternoon after a march of some sixty miles.

LTR-1864-03-01-001.ex: Algiers, La. Here we are just across the river close to New Orleans. We left Washington Feb.

LTR-1864-03-06-001.ex: Department of the Gulf New Orleans, La. I came to this place March 3d, which is Gen'l. Banks Head Quarters.

LTR-1864-03-07-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. I rec'd. your welcome letters of Feb. 14th, 18th, and 22rd and also one enclosed from Frances yesterday.

LTR-1864-03-07-002.ex: Stevenson, Ala. So you think I know you would give a thousand worlds to see me — eh?

LTR-1864-03-20-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. Here at last is the long expected letter which I have promised so often.

LTR-1864-03-25-001.ex: Headquarters Dept. of the Gulf New Orleans, La.

LTR-1864-04-01-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. Have had old warrant renewed so that I now hold my old position in the 60th Veterans.

LTR-1864-04-01-002.ex: Department of the Gulf New Orleans, La.

LTR-1864-04-06-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. The last letter I rec'd. from home was dated March 14th.

LTR-1864-04-07-001.ex: [First 8 pages missing] It has been a beautiful warm day. The weather of last month was raw and chilly most of the time.

LTR-1864-04-15-001.ex: Department of the Gulf New Orleans, La. Have rec'd no letter yet, but expect one on the steamer due today.

LTR-1864-04-18-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. I rec'd. your letter of the 4th inst. last evening.

LTR-1864-04-22-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. We are at length fully organized and now form the 20th Army Corps, Army of the Cumberland.

LTR-1864-04-23-001.ex: Dept. of the Gulf N. Orleans, La.

LTR-1864-04-25-001.ex: Hd. Qtrs. Dept of the Gulf New Orleans, La. I rec'd your letter of Apr.

LTR-1864-04-28-001.ex: Stevenson, Ala. We leave here in a day or two — perhaps tomorrow — for the front.

LTR-1864-05-03-001.ex: Alexandria, La. I arrived here yesterday and am now back with the regt.

LTR-1864-05-06-001.ex: State of Georgia I now hasten to write you a few lines to let you know of my welfare.

LTR-1864-05-08-001.ex: The mail leaves in a few minutes, and I must hasten and have my say for I know you are anxious to hear from your boys...

LTR-1864-05-10-001.ex: Camp near Buzzard's Roost, Ga. I wrote you a few days since but will not write you again that you may not be over...

LTR-1864-05-17-001.loc: Camp South of the Oostanaula River, Georgia
LTR-1864-05-17-001.ex: Camp South of the Oostanaula River Georgia I thank God that I am able to inform you that I came out of the battle on...

LTR-1864-05-20-001.ex: "At length," I can hear you say, "at length he has found time to write me a letter.

LTR-1864-05-23-001.loc: Camp on the Bank of the Mississippi River
LTR-1864-05-23-001.ex: Camp on the Bank of the Miss. River I was much surprised yesterday to see James walking into my tent. He came up from N.

LTR-1864-05-31-001.ex: Entrenchments near Dallas, Ga. I am happy to inform you that I am all right thus far. God has been very good to me.

LTR-1864-06-02-001.ex: Mississippi River Morganza Bend, State of La.

LTR-1864-06-08-001.ex: Marietta, Ga. I had, oh such a jolly good time this morning. What do you think?

LTR-1864-06-13-001.ex: Mississippi River — Morganza, La. I received your welcome letter of May 21st a few days since.

LTR-1864-06-20-001.loc: Camp in field near Marietta, Georgia
LTR-1864-06-20-001.ex: Marietta, Ga. By the kind providence of God I am permitted to write you again, and inform you that I am still uninjured.

LTR-1864-06-21-001.ex: Morganza, La. We are still encamped on the Mississippi; how long we shall remain here I cannot tell.

LTR-1864-06-22-001.ex: Morganza, La. As James wrote you yesterday I will write a few lines also and send with him today.

LTR-1864-06-29-001.ex: [Beginning missing] If any additional charge is made please let me know the amount, so I can collect of Martin his...

LTR-1864-07-00-001.loc: Camp in field near Marietta, Georgia
LTR-1864-07-00-001.ex: [Beginning missing] You see I am going to write you a long letter while I have the chance for we shall probably be...

LTR-1864-07-02-001.loc: In the Field near Marietta, Georgia
LTR-1864-07-02-001.ex: In the Field near Marietta, Ga. Must try and write you a word at least though I am pretty tired as I was up all night...

LTR-1864-07-08-001.loc: In the Field near Chattahoochee, Georgia
LTR-1864-07-08-001.ex: In the Field near Chattahoochee, Ga.

LTR-1864-07-24-001.ex: Near Atlanta, Ga. How different this Sabbath morning is with you to what it is with us.

LTR-1864-07-29-001.ex: Near Atlanta, Ga. I received your letter of the 11th inst.

LTR-1864-08-02-001.ex: Near Atlanta, Ga. I received your letter of July 17th and 18th a day or two since and was pleased to hear that you are...

LTR-1864-08-08-001.ex: [At the top of the letter was written: "My dearest child; Write me immediately."] Near Atlanta, Ga.

LTR-1864-08-08-002.ex: Capt. J. M. Ransom — I received your kind letter of July 10th some days since, but knowing as you do how we soldiers...

LTR-1864-08-15-001.ex: Baltimore, Md. It is a long while since I have written you. I think my last letter was from Morganza.

LTR-1864-08-22-001.loc: 2d Div. Hospital, 20th Corps, near Atlanta, Ga.
LTR-1864-08-22-001.ex: 2d Div. Hospital — 20th Corps Near Atlanta, Ga. You perceive that I am again in the hospital.

LTR-1864-08-26-001.ex: I received a letter from you last night dated Aug.

LTR-1864-09-02-001.ex: U. S. General Hospital Chattanooga, Tenn.

LTR-1864-09-18-001.loc: U.S. Field Hospital No. 2, Chattanooga, Tennessee
LTR-1864-09-18-001.ex: U. S. Field Hospital No. 2 Chattanooga, Tenn. Much to my gratification a day or two since the 60th N.Y. Vets.

LTR-1864-09-21-001.loc: In the field near Strasburg, Virginia
LTR-1864-09-21-001.ex: In the field near Strasburg I sit down to write you a few lines, feeling very thankful that James came out of the...

LTR-1864-09-21-002.ex: U. S. Hospital No. 2 Chattanooga, Tenn. Have you taken a realizing sense that I have now been in the U. S.

LTR-1864-09-21-003.loc: U.S. Field Hospital No. 2, Chattanooga, Tennessee
LTR-1864-09-21-003.ex: U.S. Field Hospital No. 2 Chattanooga, Tenn.

LTR-1864-10-04-001.ex: Harrisonburg In the Shenandoah Valley When did I write you last! I know it is a long time since.

LTR-1864-10-04-002.ex: Harrisonburg As the mail leaves soon I will write a few lines. I rejoined the regt. the last day of Sept.

LTR-1864-10-10-001.ex: U.S.A. Hospital No. 3 Nashville, Tenn. You perceive I have again changed my quarters.

LTR-1864-10-22-001.ex: James and I rec'd a lot of newspapers Oct. 18th and were anticipating a good deal of pleasure next day in reading them.

LTR-1864-10-29-001.ex: Patterson Park Hospital Baltimore, Md. I had a letter written and sealed which I carried in my pocket for a long time.

LTR-1864-11-04-001.ex: I read your letter announcing grandmothers death two days since. Was not surprised as she was so old.

LTR-1864-11-30-001.ex: I received your welcome letter of Nov. 22nd today containing one dollar & a silk Hdkf. also fine comb.

LTR-1864-12-05-001.ex: Nashville, Tenn. You perceive I am again in Nashville.

LTR-1864-12-09-001.ex: Chestnut Hill Hospital I received your letter, papers and package this morning.

LTR-1864-12-12-001.ex: I wrote you a letter two days since requesting you to send me a pair of boots.

LTR-1864-12-12-002.ex: Nashville, Tenn. Nothing of special interest has transpired here since I last wrote.

LTR-1864-12-27-001.ex: Near Newtown, Va. I recd. your letter of Dec. 20th two or three days since.

LTR-1865-01-11-001.ex: Champlain, N.Y. To — Alex Praise the Lord — Bless the Lord O my soul — all within me bless His holy, holy name for...

LTR-1865-06-12-001.ex: Savannah, Ga. I write in haste so that this letter will go by the steamer that leaves tonight. Our Regt.

LTR-1865-06-16-001.ex: Near Washington, D.C. You have doubtless wondered at my long silence.

LTR-1865-06-27-001.ex: Near Alexandria, Va. I advised in my last letter home that my next should be to you, so here goes.

LTR-1865-07-13-001.ex: Savannah, Ga. The last letter we received from you said, that at Uncle Henry's request you were going to Charlotte.

LTR-1865-07-27-001.ex: Ogdensburgh, N.Y. We reached here last Sat. and have been waiting for the Paymaster ever since.

LTR-1870-11-28-001.ex: Nov. 28th, 1870 Champlain, N.Y. You have never acknowledged the thirty dollar draft which I sent you about the middle...
